# Aykiz Intelligence

> Aykiz Intelligence is the independent one-person app studio of Miraz Mullick, a growth and brand marketing technologist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The studio builds quiet, offline-first, free apps for mobile and web: Wasilah, Drafy, Crisp, Verbatim, and Misbah. The name Aykiz means "moon girl".

Key facts:

- Founded and run solo by Miraz Mullick. He does the strategy, design, code, and marketing for every product himself.
- Miraz has around nine years in brand and digital marketing across agency and in-house leadership (dentsu, US-Bangla Airlines, Hajee Air) and a computer science background.
- Every Aykiz product is free to use, with no paywalls.
- The studio is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Contact: hello@aykizintelligence.com.

## Apps

- [Wasilah](https://wasilah.site/): a free Islamic companion app for Muslims in Bangladesh and Bengali-speaking Muslims worldwide. Prayer times, Adhan, Qibla, Quran, Hadith, duas, and a Zakat calculator in BDT. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Drafy](https://aykizintelligence.com/drafy/): a free static QR code generator with no paywall and no tracking. Eight QR types. Live on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/drafy-qr-code-generator/id6777504506) since June 2026 and also works as a web app. A Google Play release is in closed testing.
- [Crisp](https://aykizintelligence.com/crisp/): a free in-browser PDF toolkit. Merge, split, sign, crop, compress, stamp, and convert photos to PDF. Files are processed on-device and never uploaded.
- [Verbatim](https://aykizintelligence.com/verbatim/): free private speech-to-text transcription that runs entirely in the browser with on-device Whisper. No uploads, no accounts.
- [Misbah](https://aykizintelligence.com/misbah/): "Light in the Dark", a calm one-touch 2D game where oil is sight. No ads, no tracking, fully offline. Submitted to the App Store and Google Play in June 2026; releases expected within days. Web prototype playable at https://islamic-games-rho.vercel.app.
